news.headline: Delcath Systems Amends Bylaws to Designate Delaware Courts as Exclusive Forum
news.summary: The board amended and restated Delcath's bylaws effective 2026-08-12, making Delaware's Court of Chancery the exclusive forum for internal corporate claims and U.S. federal courts the forum for Securities Act claims. It is a routine governance update for a Delaware-incorporated company, recommended by the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee.

news.headline: Delcath Hits Fresh 12-Month High Above $17 as Analysts Lift Targets After Q2 Beat
news.summary: DCTH pushed to a new 52-week high above $17 (market cap roughly $595M) as the post-earnings rally extended, after BTIG raised its target to $21 from $17 and H.C. Wainwright to $32 from $30, both Buy. Zacks Research upgraded the stock and the consensus target moved to roughly $23, implying meaningful upside.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Presents at Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference in Boston
news.summary: Management presented to institutional investors in Boston five days after the Q2 beat, using the slot to reinforce the HEPZATO KIT commercial-ramp story and the center-activation roadmap toward roughly 37 active centers. Investor outreach at growth conferences has been a consistent part of the post-approval narrative build.

news.headline: Q2 Call: mCRC Phase 2 Now Screening at 13 Centers, Breast Cancer Program Advancing
news.summary: On the Q2 call management said the company-sponsored Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO in metastatic colorectal cancer now has 13 centers actively screening, with recruitment improving after site additions and specialized training. Management also highlighted independent ESMO Breast Cancer 2026 data showing a 60% hepatic partial response rate with percutaneous hepatic perfusion in heavily pretreated liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer.

news.headline: Delcath Reports Q2 2026: $29.1M Revenue Beats Estimates, FY Guidance Raised to $104M-$108M
news.summary: Total revenue rose to $29.1M from $24.2M a year earlier (HEPZATO KIT $27.1M, CHEMOSAT $2.0M) on roughly 30% HEPZATO volume growth, with gross margin expanding to 90% from 86%, net income of $2.7M and EPS of $0.07 versus a consensus loss of $0.09 (a $0.16-$0.17 beat). Delcath raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M and reiterated its expectation of positive adjusted EBITDA for the year; the stock jumped more than 20% on the print, its best day since May 2025.

news.headline: First Patient Dosed in DELUMA Phase 2 of HEPZATO in Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: The first patient was dosed at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in the roughly 90-patient randomized DELUMA trial (NCT06875128), testing HEPZATO plus standard of care in HER2-negative liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer. It is the company's key pipeline expansion beyond ocular melanoma into a far larger addressable indication.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: The next quarterly report is expected in early-to-mid November 2026 based on prior-year timing; no exact date has been announced yet as of 2026-08-22. It is the first checkpoint on whether HEPZATO volume growth and center activations are tracking the raised full-year guidance.

catalysts.label: 37 active HEPZATO treatment centers
catalysts.detail: Delcath exited Q2 2026 with 31 active HEPZATO KIT centers and targets roughly 37 by year-end. Center count is the most direct driver of near-term revenue, so the pace of the final activations is the key operational metric to watch.

catalysts.label: FY2026 revenue $104M-$108M and positive adjusted EBITDA
catalysts.detail: Raised guidance implies at least 28% HEPZATO volume growth over 2025 with gross margin around 90%. Management also guided to positive adjusted EBITDA for the full year, which would mark the transition to a self-funding commercial model.

catalysts.label: mCRC Phase 2 enrollment progress
catalysts.detail: The company-sponsored Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO in metastatic colorectal cancer had 13 centers actively screening as of the Q2 call, with recruitment improving. Enrollment milestones and eventual data would open the largest liver-dominant indication in the pipeline.

catalysts.label: DELUMA breast cancer Phase 2 enrollment and data
catalysts.detail: The roughly 90-patient randomized Phase 2 in HER2-negative liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer began dosing in July 2026 and is enrolling across US and EU sites. Full enrollment and first efficacy readouts are the next major pipeline catalysts, supported by independent ESMO retrospective data showing a 60% hepatic partial response rate.

pulse: Delcath remains in the strongest stretch of its commercial story so far: Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1M beat estimates by roughly $3M, gross margin hit 90%, EPS flipped to $0.07 against an expected loss, and full-year guidance was lifted to $104M-$108M with positive adjusted EBITDA expected. The stock has held fresh 52-week highs around $17 (market cap near $595M) through mid-to-late August, with BTIG at $21, H.C. Wainwright at $32 and a Zacks upgrade reinforcing the bullish sell-side tilt, while an August 12 bylaws amendment setting Delaware as the exclusive litigation forum was a routine governance item rather than a substantive development. The near-term story is pure execution -- getting from 31 to 37 active HEPZATO centers by year-end and proving the raised guidance heading into Q3 earnings expected in November -- while the DELUMA breast cancer Phase 2 and the 13-center mCRC Phase 2 carry the longer-dated optionality beyond ocular melanoma.
